result.justification: The paper clearly states its primary and secondary objectives regarding the effect of time from diagnosis to surgery on survival, and provides comprehensive methodology details.

evidence.quote: The primary aim of this study was to determine what effect time from diagnosis to surgery had on overall survival in patients undergoing potentially curable bowel resections for colonic cancer.
Data was analysed using the Chi-squared test for categorical variables or one-way ANOVA test for continuous variables.
